prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: premium editorial photograph for a local garden-care website.
Create exactly one photo. Landscape 4:3, requested resolution 2048x1536.
Primary request: An authentic relaxed mid-40s female Australian gardener with warm medium-brown skin, wearing a plain washed burgundy cotton work shirt, tan work pants and gardening gloves, kneeling beside a small raised timber garden bed and planting young herbs. Her whole figure and the whole bed are in frame. Candid slight smile, focused on her work, not posing.
Scene/backdrop: A small white weatherboard bungalow courtyard in Lane Cove, Sydney, with richly textured native plants and uneven pavers. A visible living garden occupies the left half and the gardener is on the right half. Wider environmental portrait showing the real modest home and tactile courtyard.
Style/medium: Crisp premium natural editorial photography; natural clean daylight, authentic skin and material colours, real texture, thoughtful composition.
Constraints: Believable anatomy, hands, gloves and gardening equipment; no glamour, no harbour, no broad generic mowed lawn, no mansion. No text, branding, logos, watermark, collage, CGI or oversaturation.
